function: Excluded (above_phy): the learned method DCSE, an Exp3 bandit, selects which clients join each OTA-FL round (scheduling); the power scaling factor is a fixed hyperparameter (pp. 1, 6).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 1: 'we introduce a dynamic client selection strategy termed DCSE, based on Exp3 with multiple plays'. p. 6: 'we set σt as a hyperparameter' (eq. 17), and P2 maximizes only over client sets At. Transmit power is channel inversion, sqrt(σt)/hk,t (p. 5), so no physical-layer decision is learned; the learning schedules clients. Checks 1-3 pass (research article, OTA-FL). The system check would also exclude it: scalar gain hk,t, Rayleigh fading (pp. 5, 10), no multiple antennas or RIS.
